items.title: Explicit Chebyshev hyperelliptic families with simple Jacobians and specified complex multiplication fields
items.author: Saeed Tafazolian; Jaap Top
items.difficulty_reason: The main construction realizes specified CM actions on explicit Chebyshev hyperelliptic Jacobians through quotient curves and automorphism correspondences, computes the action on invariant differentials and CM type, and proves simplicity via primitive CM types. Both original degree families form one construction object. Old188889 only classifies auxiliary cyclotomic CM fields268–323, without constructing the curves, Jacobian endomorphisms or associated CM types. Original power-of-two e>=1 case and odd-prime case scopes are retained from the complete author proof. No mathematical review, correction or computation rerun.

primary.label: Complete original main simple-CM-Jacobian theorem for power-of-two and odd-prime degrees

proof_spans.label: Complete original quotient/automorphism/differential construction, CM embedding/type and simplicity proofs for both degree families

contexts.label: Original CM Jacobian and explicit curve-family motivation
Original CM-type/primitivity, cyclotomic-field and Chebyshev definitions with complete author support proofs
